hooks.command: input=$(cat) && file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && [[ "$file" == *.css ]] && [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/stylelint ] && ./node_modules/.bin/stylelint "$file" 2>&1 | tail -20 || true

input=$(cat) && file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && [[ "$file" == *.js ]] && [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/eslint ] && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint "$file" 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
